title: The Border
openLocation: Southeastern Eversong Woods, on Farstrider patrol near the Amani frontier.
transport: Thalassian horses for Sylvanas, Lor'themar, and the mounted patrol.
immediateObjective: Finish the troll sweep, dodge the Convocation budget session, and stay outdoors one more day.
constraints: Absolute limited third on Sylvanas; no head-hopping, nothing she could not perceive or infer

Jaina stays 'the mage', 'the human', or 'the prisoner' in Sylvanas's narration and thought for the whole chapter. Cyndia says the name aloud in Beat 7 and Sylvanas knows it from then on, but her own head does not use it (outline arc: 'Even then, Jaina is still only the mage, the human, or the prisoner inside Sylvanas's head').
No Jaina dialogue anywhere in this chapter
No trust or warmth between Sylvanas and Jaina
No plague, no leyline-corruption explanation, no proof beyond one stone humming wrong
Silvermoon is not shown directly; Convocation exists only as Sylvanas's avoidance

Ward network looks stable in every formal report
Farstriders keep files on powerful human mages near the border
Jaina Proudmoore is one of the names worth watching

That a human mage has already crossed the ward boundary

castKnowsLeavingChapter: Sylvanas has felt one ward-stone read wrong and seen it circled on Jaina's map; Jaina does not know this

pov: She opens treating anything south of the wards as someone else's problem unless it touches her stones, roads, or riders.
She wants to finish the troll work, stay on her horse, and avoid the Convocation budget session.
A ward-stone hums wrong under her own palm. Then a runner reports a human mage inside the wards who says the leylines are wrong, and an easy patrol day becomes her problem.
By the end, the border mess belongs to her, and the prisoner is waiting in her own holding space.

beats: Before Sylvanas sees her, Jaina is just the human mage who ruined an easy day.
Sylvanas expects a polished Kirin Tor problem: spy, diplomat, or both.
What she finds instead is a road-worn young mage who looks exhausted, furious, and very far from court.
Even then, Jaina is still only the mage, the human, or the prisoner inside Sylvanas's head.

team.label: Partnership
beats: There is no partnership here. One woman is in custody, and the other decides how hard the door stays shut.
Jaina shifts from paperwork headache to the one person Sylvanas has to hear out.
The chapter ends on their first hard face-to-face with no warmth and no softening.

castAndHandoffRules: Lor'themar Theron: present in Scene 1; exits north in Scene 1 to brief the Convocation.
Mounted patrol: present in Scene 1; leaves north with Lor'themar once the report lands.
Farstrider runner: Scene 1 only; delivers the report, then rides south with Sylvanas to the post.
Ranger Cyndia: enters in Scene 2 as border-post officer; remains active into Chapter 2.
Jaina Proudmoore: seen in Scene 2, does not speak on-page.
Next chapter opens at Cyndia's post on the interrogation beat; Lor'themar and patrol already northbound.

scene.title: The Prisoner
scene.sceneFunction: A generic border arrest becomes a high-stakes problem that locks both women into the next chapter.
scene.knowledgeAtSceneStart: A human mage is in a holding cell. No verified identity, no trusted warning. Sylvanas has felt one stone read wrong and arrives with the runner.

beats.goal: Get Cyndia's raw account of the arrest.
beats.conflict: The facts make the mage stranger, not clearer: she argued to stay and work instead of bolting.

outcome.summary: Report is close enough to Sylvanas's stone that she demands the gear and the prisoner at once.

newOnPageInformation: The mage got through the outer ring before dawn, was stopped at the second ring, and argued to stay and work instead of bolting
Stones read as if malfunctioning from something inside them
Her staff and gear are in lockdown
stillUnknownAfterBeat: Whether the human is arrogant, terrified, or right
beats.transitionIntent: action continuation: she heads for the prisoner and stops at the lockdown rack on the way

beats.goal: Inspect the prisoner's staff, kit and map before facing her.
beats.conflict: The map is a puzzle: circled stones could be survey or target list, and one is the stone she checked this morning.

outcome.summary: The map ties the mage to Sylvanas's own stone, and Cyndia names the prisoner.

newOnPageInformation: Hand-drawn human map of Thalassian ward sites with lines run from the south
The stone Sylvanas checked this morning is circled
Kirin Tor ink and staff make match the Farstrider file
Prisoner is Jaina Proudmoore, Antonidas's apprentice
stillUnknownAfterBeat: How the mage knew to circle that stone
Whether the map is a survey or a target list

staff crystal dim under dampening ward

beats.transitionIntent: planted question: the name and the circled stone send her to the cell door
beats.intraChapterEcho: Beat 2 stone: the circled site is the stone she checked this morning

beats.goal: Open the door on the polished Kirin Tor nuisance she expects.
beats.conflict: The prisoner is road-worn, furious and exhausted, nothing like the file in her head.

outcome.summary: Expectation breaks and the matter becomes a diplomatic and magical incident with a famous name.

newOnPageInformation: Jaina is young, in worn practical gear, frost-burned knuckles, ink-stained, furious that nobody believes her
This is now a diplomatic and magical incident

sensoryAnchors: empty pegs where a staff would hang
beats.transitionIntent: emotional carryover: her broken expectation has her reading the prisoner again from the start, and the prisoner reads her back
beats.povNote: Sylvanas cannot know directly that the prisoner is 'furious that nobody believes her'. She infers it from Cyndia's report (Beat 6: argued to stay and work) and from what she sees. Keep it as her reading, not omniscient fact.

beats.emotion: Wary curiosity as the prisoner reads her back.
beats.dilemma: Throw her out, or let her stew, versus hearing her now.
beats.decision: Neither dismissal nor delay; hear her now.

beats.transitionIntent: planted question: the silence in the cell holds until someone breaks it; she steps in front of the chair
beats.plannerWarning: No Jaina dialogue is permitted in this chapter; her reading of the stone must come through eyes and posture only.

beats.emotion: Temper shoved down; anger at Antonidas and at the mage for matching her file.
beats.dilemma: Escort her home, or hold her and wait on a magister.
beats.decision: She takes the floor in front of the chair and opens the interrogation, closing the chapter on the outline's fixed final line ('Start talking.').
newOnPageInformation: Release is impossible and stalling is riskier

angry at Antonidas, and at the mage for being exactly what her file says

beats.plannerWarning: Final line is outline-mandated and quoted in the outline; writer should not replay it at the start of Chapter 2.
beats.povNote: Beat 8 breaks Sylvanas's picture of the prisoner (court-polished diplomat). Beat 10's 'exactly what her file says' refers to the Farstrider file's facts: powerful, Antonidas's apprentice, Kirin Tor. These are two different things, and the prose should not make Beat 8 and Beat 10 read as contradicting each other.
